notes.title: Major Maintenance Update 2.0
notes.notes:
As part of our ongoing maintenance efforts between projects, we’re happy to announce that a new update to Reaper is now available on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5623602/a3e3baffccdceee9b69dacd57a6878b7c570e32e.gif[/img]

The key improvements include sharper, clearer graphics and much smoother animations, along with enhanced support for ultrawide screens and high refresh rates. The game should sync with your monitor’s refresh rate, and we highly recommend enabling V-Sync in your driver settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5623602/b2c06301d2251594d5a43a067e724cf06be61e3f.png[/img]

Other notable updates include:
[list]
[*] Higher-quality music and sound effects files.
[*] Improved font rendering with better kerning.
[*] Better UI navigation for game controllers with proper glyphs (PS/Xbox).
[*] Minor gameplay tweaks, such as easier collection of nearby gold coins and nuggets.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5623602/1fe14311db2fdcacecff96fad9f5a46350ec2043.png[/img]

Please note that this update is not compatible with older hardware, like systems with Intel Celeron integrated GPUs. However, the old version of the game remains available on Steam via the "legacy" channel.

[url=https://discord.com/channels/1131304903139151892/1134441899965558845]Learn more on our Discord[/url]

notes.title: Reaper has been released for Mac and Linux
notes.notes:
Mac and Linux/SteamOS versions of Reaper are now available on Steam.

Anyone who has previously purchased the Windows version will have access to the game on all three platforms automatically.  The save files are fully compatible, and you can synchronize the game progress across different platforms.

Steam Controller and Xbox controllers are supported on all platforms. On Mac OS X, we recommend the [url=https://github.com/360Controller/360Controller/releases]360Controller[/url] driver.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Reaper - Tale of a Pale Swordsman
notes.notes:
Reaper - Tale of a Pale Swordsman is Now Available on Steam!

Enter the world ripe with magic and monsters. Become the Black Swordsman and slay thousands of enemies in an epic action RPG! War broke between the industrious Imperium and the savage tribes of Wilderness. Demons and carrions have returned to the land. Play all sides and make your own decisions. Take countless quests and uncover the secrets of Wilderness...

Level up your character with skills of your choice. Select from more than 30 unique & tiered skills to improve your character. Loot gold from slain enemies, find treasures and negotiate quest rewards. Choose from hundreds of exquisite armors, swords and accessories.
